messages:
acme_ops: Hi team — ACME reports their Azure Accelerator credits from marketplace order `0d4c2b9f` were marked delivered on 2024-06-23 but nothing appears in their Redwood account balance. They’re blocked on smoke tests. Can someone check entitlement delivery and ledger?

shani_support: Thanks for the heads up. Can you paste the marketplace order id, azure subscription id, and our Redwood account id? Also any screenshots of the marketplace portal would help.

acme_ops: Order: `0d4c2b9f`
Azure sub: `f8b1-8a23-xxxx-9e7a`
Marketplace entitlement id: `ent-az-20240623-ACME`
Redwood acct id: `red-ACME-9982`
Screenshot: marketplace shows status = "Entitlement delivered" and timestamp 2024-06-23T14:12Z.

billing-bot: [webhook] received entitlement_event order=0d4c2b9f status=delivered tenant_id=f8b1-8a23 -> enqueued for processing

rahul_engineer: Looking at the webhook logs. The initial webhook payload had `publisherId` empty which prevented our mapping to the partner record. We try to map by `azure_tenant` as fallback but tenant `f8b1-8a23` maps to `acme-enterprise-legacy` in our DB, not `red-ACME-9982`.

rahul_engineer: I'll attempt a manual reprocess for order `0d4c2b9f` with relaxMapping=true to see if it binds to the correct account. Command I ran:

```
curl -X POST "https://internal-billing/retry" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"order_id":"0d4c2b9f","relaxMapping":true}'
```

rahul_engineer: Reprocess returned `202 Accepted` but post-check shows no ledger entry created. Logs show: `ERROR: No customer account found for azure_tenant: f8b1-8a23 (mapping: acme-enterprise-legacy)`

sam_billing: FYI — that azure_tenant used to be tied to ACME's legacy enterprise account before they consolidated in April. Partner success updated mapping in partner-db, but I think our billing sync job didn't pick up the change. @jules_ps can you confirm if partner-db has the updated mapping?

jules_ps: Confirmed partner-db: tenant `f8b1-8a23` -> `red-ACME-9982` as of 2024-04-12. However our ingestion pipeline `partner-sync` last ran on 2024-05-01 due to a config drift. That explains the mismatch.

sam_billing: Ok — two things: 1) we can run a backfill to reconcile existing marketplace entitlements to the new mapping; 2) customer needs immediate credits to continue. Finance, can we provision a temporary credit while we fix the ingestion backfill? Tagging @rahul_engineer for automation implications.

rahul_engineer: Manual provisional credit is safe if we flag it `provisional_marketplace` and add order id into reconciliation table. I'll add idempotency guard to avoid double-credit if the webhook later applies correctly.

sam_billing: I'll create provisional credit now: `PRV-2024-06-23-ACME` amount $2,000 (trial accelerator). GL code `ACC-TRIAL-410`. Will mark for reconciliation against order `0d4c2b9f`.

shani_support: Please confirm when provisional credit is applied so I can tell the customer. Also keep finance in the loop for final reversal if needed.

billing-bot: [action] provisional_credit created id=PRV-2024-06-23-ACME amount=2000 account=red-ACME-9982 status=pending_reconcile created_by=sam_billing

rahul_engineer: I pushed a small change to the billing reprocesser to prefer partner-db mapping and to ignore orders that have a `provisional_marketplace` flag. Change id `chg-8271`, deployed to staging. When we run the backfill we should re-run the `entitlement-reconcile` job for the date range 2024-06-01..2024-06-30.

jules_ps: I'll trigger partner-sync and then run the backfill for June range. ETA ~ 30m.

billing-bot: partner-sync job started (job-id: ps-20240623-01)

billing-bot: partner-sync job completed (job-id: ps-20240623-01) — mappings updated: tenant f8b1-8a23 -> red-ACME-9982

rahul_engineer: Backfill job `entitlement-reconcile` completed. It found order `0d4c2b9f` and created ledger entry +$2,000 linked to `red-ACME-9982`. Reconciliation table shows match to provisional credit `PRV-2024-06-23-ACME` and flagged "needs reversal" for the provisional.

billing-bot: entitlement 0d4c2b9f applied: ledger +2000 account=red-ACME-9982. reconciliation_status=matched -> provisional_credit PRV-2024-06-23-ACME queued for reversal.

sam_billing: I've approved GL reversal for provisional credit. Finance will post reversal and confirm in the ledger.

billing-bot: provisional_credit PRV-2024-06-23-ACME reversal posted. ledger now shows only the marketplace-applied credit.

acme_ops: Confirmed — ACME sees the $2,000 credit in their account now and tests are green. Thank you so much! :rocket:

shani_support: Great. Marking as resolved for now. Leaving ticket open until finance confirms final reconciled entries in the month-end report.

sam_billing: Note for postmortem: add alert if partner-sync hasn't run in >24h and add unit test for empty `publisherId` payloads.

rahul_engineer: Will add the alert and test. chg-8279 to follow up.

acme_ops: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Closing our side once finance confirms.

shani_support: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
